payload.name: Search Event and Plan Kinds for Replacement Activities
payload.description: When a question asks what someone did or planned instead of, rather than, or as an alternative to a named activity, include event and plan memory kinds and search with replacement-oriented terms.
content: Do not restrict retrieval to memory kinds profile and relationship when looking for an alternative or replacement activity; include event and plan, because planned replacements are often stored as event or plan memories.
Run at least one query that combines the person's name with replacement-oriented terms such as 'plan', 'play', 'together', 'instead', or 'want to try' and omits the superseded activity.

If the first results only mention the superseded activity or another subject, run one more query using candidate activity nouns from retrieved memories before answering; stop once a same-subject memory explicitly describes the replacement.

solves: When a question asks what activity someone did or planned instead of a named activity, retrieval can fail because searches are restricted to profile and relationship memory kinds and remain anchored on the superseded activity, while the actual replacement is stored as an event or plan memory with different activity terms.
